$comment: Branches listed on https://chajoybd.odoo.com/our-franchises (retrieved 2026-10-19). Addresses are transcribed from the branch photos on that page where the photo shows one. No branch published coordinates, phone numbers, opening hours, delivery zones or fees; those stay empty until CHAJOY confirms them. Pins are approximate area locations geocoded from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL) and are labelled as approximate everywhere they are shown.
